name: ZhD
source:
A road on the train is a road to yourself.
A sound of wheels, a smell of railroads, a meaningless chatter of travelers...this meditative road mood helps to rethink life, and to arrive at the station another person....There is a story that happened with a young girl in this tiny visual novel. Obsessed with vengeance, she goes to her father to punish him for betrayal. And she can't imagine how this train car, this road, and these travelers will change her life.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1765510/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
火车上的路就是一条通往自己的路。
车轮的声音、铁路的气味、旅行者毫无意义的闲聊……这种冥想的道路情绪有助于重新思考生活，并以另一个人的方式到达车站……在这本小小的视觉小说中，有一个发生在一个年轻女孩身上的故事。她一心想报仇，于是去找父亲惩罚他的背叛。她无法想象这节车厢、这条路、这些旅客将如何改变她的生活。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1765510/]Steam[/url]]
